name: dsh-plugin-sage-subagent
description: Named, file-defined subagent roles for DeepSeek Harness: persona, subagent-only skills, tool permissions, an ordered model chain with failover, and a runtime coexist/takeover switch for the delegation tool.

comments.peers: All @deepseek-ai peers are declared '*' on purpose: the plugin resolves them through the $DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules junction bridge, so a DSH upgrade never requires touching this file. See README '模块解析'.
comments.yaml: The only runtime third-party import; it is provided by the same junction bridge, not by installing this package's dependencies.

author: gezi-wen
